targetTest: list_products registered tool (in-memory MCP round trip) > UXT-040: an agent's shopId and availableOnly survive the schema and reach core
expected: an MCP call to list_products with shopId and availableOnly reaches core as /api/v1/products?shopId=<uuid>&availableOnly=true; a non-UUID shopId and a non-boolean availableOnly are refused before core; unknown keys never reach the query string
actual: core is called with /api/v1/products and no query: the registered raw Zod shape has only page and size, so the SDK's parse strips shopId and availableOnly silently and the agent gets the tenant's whole catalogue (UXT-040); a non-UUID shopId is not refused at all (isError undefined)
semanticAssessment: Run on the committed RED tree 0430cdf3 before any production edit (mcp-server identical to HEAD). vitest loaded the file and ran 10 tests, 6 failed, each on its planned assertion: the handler and the round trip call core without the two parameters (the Zod strip the plan's fail arm names); the non-UUID shopId arm got no isError and the boolean arm saw core called once, because unknown keys are stripped rather than refused; the unknown-keys arm expected the shopId query; the schema arm lists only [page, size]. The 4 existing arms passed, so the harness can pass. No load, import or fixture fault. A first TAP capture of the same run piped stdout, where list-products.ts's real pino logger writes JSON lines ahead of the TAP stream; the classifier refused it (invalid_record, unsupported format) and tap-flat ignores --outputFile, so this record is vitest's JUnit report file, with the console (pino lines) kept out of it.
